bitcoin_articles.headline: Better and Coinbase Fund First Fannie Mae-Backed Bitcoin Mortgage
bitcoin_articles.summary: Better Home & Finance and Coinbase have successfully funded the first Fannie Mae-eligible mortgage backed by Bitcoin, with plans for a nationwide rollout by Summer 2026.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Better Home & Finance and Coinbase Announce Funding of First Bitcoin-Backed Mortgage
bitcoin_articles.summary: Better Home & Finance Holding Company and Coinbase have successfully funded the first Fannie Mae-backed mortgage in the U.S. that uses Bitcoin as collateral.

bitcoin_articles.headline: CleanSpark Releases May 2026 Operational Update
bitcoin_articles.summary: CleanSpark, Inc. has released its monthly operational update for May 2026, detailing its bitcoin production, operational capacity, and holdings.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Landon Capital Initiates Buy Rating on LM Funding America
bitcoin_articles.summary: Analyst Mohammed Saqib of Landon Capital initiated coverage of LM Funding America, Inc. with a Buy rating, citing the company's Bitcoin treasury and mining operations.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Empery Digital Files for Share Sale
bitcoin_articles.summary: Empery Digital Inc. has filed for a new share sale, creating market pressure regarding the company's previously announced Bitcoin treasury strategy.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Deposits 5,212 BTC and 20,000 ETH into Coinbase
bitcoin_articles.summary: On June 4, 2026, BlackRock transferred 5,212 BTC and 20,000 ETH to the Coinbase exchange as part of its routine operational management of digital assets.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust Records $2.43 Billion in Outflows and Transfers 6,005 BTC to Coinbase
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) experienced $2.43 billion in outflows, alongside a transfer of 6,005 BTC to Coinbase, reflecting significant recent activity in the firm's digital asset holdings.
